recruit_text.greeting: Siéntate, siéntate, sorry, in English, sit down, you look terrible, and I say that with love, my friend, with love.
recruit_text.backstory: He cut hair in Santurce for eleven years in a shop that was really the neighbourhood's whole social life, where everybody told him everything because a barber is a priest with better gossip. He talks constantly and listens harder than anybody notices. The spirits took to him immediately, and he treats them the way he treated his chair: sit down, tell me what's wrong, I'm going to fix it and we're going to talk the whole time.
recruit_text.before:
Two chairs, a radio always on, and a Tuesday regular called Don Beni who came in for nineteen years and didn't need a haircut once.

His whole family were on the island. He says they're fine. He has a reason he believes it, and he'll tell you the reason, and the reason is thin, and everybody lets him have it.
recruit_text.adjustment:
He was running a chair inside a month, in a tent, with a borrowed blade.

It was the most effective adjustment anybody made, and the reason is simple: he rebuilt the room. Everything good he had on Earth came from a place where people sat down and talked, so he made one here before he worried about anything else.
recruit_text.forward:
A shop, properly, with a floor and a mirror.

He has the blade. He's had three offers of a building. He's turned all three down and can't explain why to anybody, including himself, and his hands shook on the last one.
recruit_text.now:
The Shadowpine Altar on Fenris Isle, where the trolls taught him the spirits and let him keep a chair by the fire. Wherever the party stops becomes a shop for as long as they're there.

He'll cut anybody's hair, any race, free, and nobody's refused him twice.

stages.stranger: I'm Orlando, mi amor, and I'm a witch doctor, and a barber, which is basically the same job. Sit down, tell me everything, and let me fix that hair while you talk. With love, it needs fixing.
stages.acquaintance: I'm from Santurce, in San Juan, Puerto Rico. My papi fixed buses and my mami cooked at a school, and our house was full of aunts and cousins all the time. I swept up at a barbershop at fourteen and had my own shop at twenty-two. Two chairs, the radio always on. Everybody told me everything, and I never repeated one word.
stages.companion: My whole family was on the island, nene. Mami, Papi, my little sister Yari, who's my best friend, and about forty aunts and cousins. A Puerto Rican trader told me once that the island came through whole, somewhere across the sea. I know it's a thin thing to hold on to. I hold on to it anyway, and everybody lets me.
stages.friend: There was a man, Gabriel, a nurse. We'd been together a year and it was going really well. He'd started leaving a toothbrush at my place, you know what that means. I've had three offers of a building for a real shop and I said no to all three, and my hands shook on the last one. I think I know why now. That trader's in Booty Bay. I want to ask him more. Come with me, mi amor.
stages.sworn: The island's there, whole, my family and all, and no ship can reach it. The sea turned us back and nearly sank us, you were there. So they're probably alive, all of them, and I can't ever get to them. I stood at the rail a long time. Then I came home and took the next building, and my hands didn't shake. It's called Casa Rivera, after Mami's house. There's an empty chair for Don Beni. Everybody in that chair is family now.

moments.prompt: He's asked you to come to Booty Bay to find the trader.

options.text: Let's go and hear what he knows.
options.reply: Wepa, let's go! Okay, okay, I'm nervous, so I'm going to talk the whole way. Sorry, with love.
Then at least it's news, nene. I've lived on nothing for three years.

moments.prompt: After the wipe, for once he's completely silent.
moments.line: Ay bendito, that was horrible. I need everybody to say something, anything, because I can't stand the quiet.

options.reply: Okay, okay, that's better. So first, the spirits were telling me left, and nobody went left.
A minute of quiet is a very long time for me, my friend.

lines.bored_warning: Mi amor, we've been doing the same thing for days and nobody's even talking. Let's go somewhere with people, please, I'm dying here.
lines.leaving_good: That was wonderful, all of you, with love. I'm going back to the Shadowpine Altar to see my trolls. Come and get a haircut.
lines.leaving_bored: I'm going back to Fenris. Nothing's happening, and I've got a chair by the fire that's lonely.
lines.after_wipe: Ay bendito, everybody come here. I'm going to fix you and talk the whole time, and you're going to let me.
lines.wipe_warning: We keep dying in here, nene, and it's breaking my heart. One more run, then I need some days by my fire.
lines.wipe_leave: I stayed till the end, with love. Now I'm going home to Fenris for a while. Come and find me.
lines.zone_warning: Mi amor, everything out here wants to kill us, and not in a fun way. Let's go somewhere we can handle.
lines.zone_leave: I'm stopping here. It's too much out there. I'll be at the Shadowpine Altar.
lines.gear_refuse: Ay, no, that's mine, mi amor. Ask me again when you're a regular.
lines.gear_taken: Take it, take it, I'll look fabulous without it.
lines.gear_short: I'm still missing that piece, nene. I'm saying it with love, but I'm saying it.
lines.gear_upgrade: Wepa, it's gorgeous, thank you. You have excellent taste, I always said so.
lines.back: I'm back, and I brought my razor! Sit down, everybody, you all look terrible, with love.
lines.send_word: Orlando has sent word from the Shadowpine Altar. His chair's empty and he's ready to come out.
lines.walkout_talk: I left angry, mi amor, and you know I'm never angry. Sit, let me do your hair, and I'll tell you why while I work.
lines.neglect: There you are! I thought you'd found another barber. That's the worst betrayal there is, you know.
lines.asked_to_stay: Okay, okay, one more, but I'm doing everyone's hair tonight.
lines.on_break: Orlando is back at the Shadowpine Altar, cutting hair by the fire. Come back after you've done a few more jobs.

town_arrive.text: Look at this place, everybody needs a haircut. I'm going to make so many friends.
Santurce is all music and murals and somebody's grandmother on every porch. You'd love it.

boss_down.text: Wepa, the spirits liked that one. They're very loud right now.

dungeon_clear.text: That place was so lonely. Nobody's talked down there in years.

close_call.text: Ay bendito, come here, sit down, let me look at you. Keep talking to me.
